package guild

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	poster  = testutils.TestAddress("poster")
	worker  = testutils.TestAddress("worker")
	worker2 = testutils.TestAddress("worker2")
	rando   = testutils.TestAddress("rando")
)

const (
	h0           = int64(1000)
	leaseBlocks  = int64(600)
	reviewBlocks = int64(1200)
	deadline     = h0 + 10000
	reward       = int64(5000000)
)

func newValidQuest(t *testing.T) *Quest {
	q, err := New(1, poster, "Write tests", "cover the avl package", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, h0)
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	return q
}

func newClaimedQuest(t *testing.T) *Quest {
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Claim(worker, h0))
	return q
}

func newSubmittedQuest(t *testing.T) *Quest {
	q := newClaimedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Submit(worker, h0+10, "https://example.com/proof", "done"))
	return q
}

func TestNew(t *testing.T) {
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), q.ID)
	uassert.Equal(t, poster, q.Poster)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Write tests", q.Title)
	uassert.Equal(t, reward, q.Reward)
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Open)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(q.History))
	uassert.Equal(t, "posted", q.History[0].Action)
	uassert.Equal(t, poster, q.History[0].Actor)
	uassert.Equal(t, h0, q.History[0].Height)
}

func TestNew_TrimsTitle(t *testing.T) {
	q, err := New(1, poster, "  padded title  ", "", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, h0)
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, "padded title", q.Title)
}

func TestNew_Validation(t *testing.T) {
	longTitle := strings.Repeat("t", MaxTitle+1)
	longSpec := strings.Repeat("s", MaxSpec+1)

	cases := []struct {
		name    string
		poster  address
		title   string
		spec    string
		reward  int64
		lease   int64
		review  int64
		dl      int64
		wantErr error
	}{
		{"bad poster", address("bogus"), "t", "", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrInvalidPoster},
		{"empty title", poster, "", "", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrEmptyTitle},
		{"blank title", poster, "   ", "", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrEmptyTitle},
		{"long title", poster, longTitle, "", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrTitleTooLong},
		{"long spec", poster, "t", longSpec, reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrSpecTooLong},
		{"zero reward", poster, "t", "", 0, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrInvalidReward},
		{"negative reward", poster, "t", "", -5, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrInvalidReward},
		{"lease too small", poster, "t", "", reward, MinBlocks - 1, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrInvalidLease},
		{"lease too big", poster, "t", "", reward, MaxBlocks + 1, reviewBlocks, deadline, ErrInvalidLease},
		{"review too small", poster, "t", "", reward, leaseBlocks, MinBlocks - 1, deadline, ErrInvalidReview},
		{"review too big", poster, "t", "", reward, leaseBlocks, MaxBlocks + 1, deadline, ErrInvalidReview},
		{"deadline inside lease", poster, "t", "", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, h0 + leaseBlocks, ErrInvalidDeadline},
		{"deadline before lease", poster, "t", "", reward, leaseBlocks, reviewBlocks, h0 + leaseBlocks - 1, ErrInvalidDeadline},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		_, err := New(1, tc.poster, tc.title, tc.spec, tc.reward, tc.lease, tc.review, tc.dl, h0)
		uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, tc.wantErr, tc.name)
	}

	// Boundary values that must be accepted.
	_, err := New(1, poster, strings.Repeat("t", MaxTitle), strings.Repeat("s", MaxSpec),
		reward, MinBlocks, MaxBlocks, deadline, h0)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestClaim(t *testing.T) {
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Claim(worker, h0+50))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Claimed)
	uassert.Equal(t, worker, q.Worker)
	uassert.Equal(t, h0+50+leaseBlocks, q.LeaseEnd)
	uassert.Equal(t, "claimed", q.History[len(q.History)-1].Action)
}

func TestClaim_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Claim(poster, h0), ErrSelfClaim, "poster cannot claim")

	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Claim(worker, deadline), ErrPastDeadline, "at deadline")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Claim(worker, deadline+1), ErrPastDeadline, "past deadline")

	claimed := newClaimedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, claimed.Claim(worker2, h0+1), ErrNotOpen, "live claim blocks second claim")
	uassert.Equal(t, worker, claimed.Worker, "failed claim must not mutate worker")

	for _, s := range []Status{Submitted, Paid, Refunded, Cancelled} {
		qq := newValidQuest(t)
		qq.Status = s
		uassert.ErrorIs(t, qq.Claim(worker, h0), ErrNotOpen, s.String())
	}
}

func TestClaim_StaleLease(t *testing.T) {
	q := newClaimedQuest(t)
	after := q.LeaseEnd + 1
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Claim(worker2, after))
	uassert.Equal(t, worker2, q.Worker)
	uassert.Equal(t, after+leaseBlocks, q.LeaseEnd)

	// The stale claim is recorded as expired before the new claim.
	n := len(q.History)
	uassert.Equal(t, "expired", q.History[n-2].Action)
	uassert.Equal(t, worker.String(), q.History[n-2].Detail)
	uassert.Equal(t, "claimed", q.History[n-1].Action)
}

func TestSubmit(t *testing.T) {
	q := newClaimedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Submit(worker, h0+100, "https://proof.example/1", "all done"))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Submitted)
	uassert.Equal(t, "https://proof.example/1", q.ProofURL)
	uassert.Equal(t, "all done", q.Note)
	uassert.Equal(t, h0+100, q.SubmittedAt)

	// Submitting exactly at the lease end is still valid.
	q2 := newClaimedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q2.Submit(worker, q2.LeaseEnd, "https://proof.example/2", ""))
	uassert.True(t, q2.Status == Submitted)
}

func TestSubmit_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	open := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, open.Submit(worker, h0, "u", ""), ErrNotClaimed, "open quest")

	q := newClaimedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Submit(worker2, h0, "u", ""), ErrNotWorker, "wrong worker")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Submit(worker, q.LeaseEnd+1, "u", ""), ErrLeaseExpired, "stale lease")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Submit(worker, h0, "", ""), ErrProofURLEmpty, "empty proof")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Submit(worker, h0, "   ", ""), ErrProofURLEmpty, "blank proof")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Submit(worker, h0, strings.Repeat("u", MaxURL+1), ""), ErrProofURLTooLong, "long proof")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Submit(worker, h0, "u", strings.Repeat("n", MaxNote+1)), ErrNoteTooLong, "long note")

	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Claimed, "failed submits must not mutate")
	uassert.Equal(t, "", q.ProofURL)
}

func TestAccept(t *testing.T) {
	q := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Accept(poster, h0+500))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Paid)
	uassert.False(t, q.AutoPaid)

	// Acceptance has no time limit: valid even after the review window.
	q2 := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q2.Accept(poster, q2.ReviewEnd()+1))
	uassert.True(t, q2.Status == Paid)
}

func TestAccept_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	open := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, open.Accept(poster, h0), ErrNotSubmitted, "open quest")

	q := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Accept(rando, h0), ErrNotPoster, "non-poster")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Accept(worker, h0), ErrNotPoster, "worker is not poster")
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Submitted)
}

func TestReject(t *testing.T) {
	q := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	uassert.NoError(t, q.Reject(poster, h0+500, "needs more detail"))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Open)
	uassert.Equal(t, address(""), q.Worker)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), q.LeaseEnd)
	uassert.Equal(t, "", q.ProofURL)
	uassert.Equal(t, "", q.Note)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), q.SubmittedAt)

	last := q.History[len(q.History)-1]
	uassert.Equal(t, "rejected", last.Action)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(last.Detail, worker.String()), "detail keeps old worker")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(last.Detail, "needs more detail"), "detail keeps reason")

	// Rejected quest is claimable again by a different worker.
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Claim(worker2, h0+600))
	uassert.Equal(t, worker2, q.Worker)
}

func TestReject_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	open := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, open.Reject(poster, h0, "r"), ErrNotSubmitted, "open quest")

	q := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Reject(rando, h0, "r"), ErrNotPoster, "non-poster")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Reject(poster, q.ReviewEnd()+1, "r"), ErrReviewClosed, "past review window")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Reject(poster, h0, strings.Repeat("r", MaxNote+1)), ErrReasonTooLong, "long reason")

	// Reject exactly at the review end is still valid.
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Reject(poster, q.ReviewEnd(), "ok"))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Open)
}

func TestAutoAccept(t *testing.T) {
	q := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.AutoAccept(worker, q.ReviewEnd()+1))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Paid)
	uassert.True(t, q.AutoPaid)
	uassert.Equal(t, "auto-accepted", q.History[len(q.History)-1].Action)
}

func TestAutoAccept_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	open := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, open.AutoAccept(worker, h0), ErrNotSubmitted, "open quest")

	q := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.AutoAccept(worker, q.ReviewEnd()), ErrReviewOpen, "at review end")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.AutoAccept(rando, q.ReviewEnd()+1), ErrNotWorker, "non-worker")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.AutoAccept(poster, q.ReviewEnd()+1), ErrNotWorker, "poster is not worker")
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Submitted)
	uassert.False(t, q.AutoPaid)
}

func TestRefund(t *testing.T) {
	// Open quest refunded at the deadline.
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Refund(poster, deadline))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Refunded)

	// Stale-claimed quest refunded after the deadline.
	q2 := newClaimedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q2.Refund(poster, deadline+1))
	uassert.True(t, q2.Status == Refunded)
}

func TestRefund_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Refund(poster, deadline-1), ErrBeforeDeadline, "before deadline")
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Refund(rando, deadline), ErrNotPoster, "non-poster")

	sub := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, sub.Refund(poster, deadline+999), ErrSubmittedPending, "submitted can never refund")

	paid := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, paid.Accept(poster, h0+1))
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, paid.Refund(poster, deadline+999), ErrNotOpen, "paid is terminal")
}

func TestCancel(t *testing.T) {
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q.Cancel(poster, h0+1))
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == Cancelled)

	// A claim whose lease went stale is cancellable too.
	q2 := newClaimedQuest(t)
	urequire.NoError(t, q2.Cancel(poster, q2.LeaseEnd+1))
	uassert.True(t, q2.Status == Cancelled)
}

func TestCancel_Rejects(t *testing.T) {
	q := newValidQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, q.Cancel(rando, h0), ErrNotPoster, "non-poster")

	claimed := newClaimedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, claimed.Cancel(poster, h0+1), ErrNotOpen, "live claim blocks cancel")
	uassert.True(t, claimed.Status == Claimed)

	sub := newSubmittedQuest(t)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, sub.Cancel(poster, h0+1), ErrNotOpen, "submitted blocks cancel")
}

func TestStatusString(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "open", Open.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "claimed", Claimed.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "submitted", Submitted.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "paid", Paid.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "refunded", Refunded.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "cancelled", Cancelled.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "unknown", Status(99).String())
}

files.body:
package guildhall

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"chain"
	"chain/banker"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nym-ololade001/guild/v0"
)

const (
	pkgPath     = "gno.land/r/nym-ololade001/guildhall/v1"
	questReward = int64(5000000) // 5 GNOT
	lease       = int64(600)
	review      = int64(1200)
	baseH       = int64(1000)
	deadline    = baseH + 10000
)

var (
	poster  = testutils.TestAddress("poster")
	worker  = testutils.TestAddress("worker")
	worker2 = testutils.TestAddress("worker2")
	rando   = testutils.TestAddress("rando")
)

func realmAddr() address {
	return chain.PackageAddress(pkgPath)
}

func resetTestState() {
	quests = avl.NewTree()
	active = avl.NewTree()
	profiles = avl.NewTree()
	questSeq = 0
	escrowTotal = 0
	paidTotal = 0
}

func ugnot(amt int64) chain.Coins {
	return chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin("ugnot", amt))
}

func mustQuestTest(t *testing.T, id uint64) *guild.Quest {
	q, ok := quests.Get(questKey(id)).(*guild.Quest)
	urequire.True(t, ok && q != nil, "quest exists")
	return q
}

func balanceOf(a address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(a, "ugnot")
}

// NOTE: testing.SetRealm and testing.SetOriginSend only take effect in the
// frame that runs them, so the realm calls below stay inline in the test
// bodies rather than moving behind helpers.

func TestPost(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)

	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr(), ugnot(questReward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	id := Post(cross(cur), "Test quest", "do the thing", lease, review, deadline)
	uassert.Equal(t, uint64(1), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, escrowTotal)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, active.Size())

	q := mustQuestTest(t, id)
	uassert.Equal(t, poster, q.Poster)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Test quest", q.Title)
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == guild.Open)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, q.Reward)

	p := findProfile(poster)
	urequire.NotNil(t, p)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, p.Posted)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(p.PostedIDs))
}

func TestPost_Rejects(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)

	// No send at all.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "ugnot", func() {
		Post(cross(cur), "t", "", lease, review, deadline)
	})

	// Wrong denom.
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin("foo", 100)))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "ugnot", func() {
		Post(cross(cur), "t", "", lease, review, deadline)
	})

	// Two coins, even if one is ugnot.
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{
		chain.NewCoin("ugnot", 100),
		chain.NewCoin("foo", 100),
	})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "ugnot", func() {
		Post(cross(cur), "t", "", lease, review, deadline)
	})

	// A code realm cannot post even with a send attached: IsUserCall and
	// OriginSend are a pair (maketx run / intermediary realms could spend
	// the envelope first).
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm(pkgPath))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "Post must be called directly by a user (maketx call)", func() {
		Post(cross(cur), "t", "", lease, review, deadline)
	})

	uassert.Equal(t, 0, quests.Size(), "no quest stored")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), escrowTotal)
}

func TestPost_InvalidArgs(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr(), ugnot(questReward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	// Deadline inside the first lease window.
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "deadline", func() {
		Post(cross(cur), "t", "", lease, review, baseH+lease)
	})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "lease", func() {
		Post(cross(cur), "t", "", guild.MinBlocks-1, review, deadline)
	})
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, quests.Size())
}

func TestHappyPath(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)

	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr(), ugnot(questReward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	id := Post(cross(cur), "Test quest", "do the thing", lease, review, deadline)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(worker))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://proof.example/1", "done")

	before := balanceOf(worker)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	Accept(cross(cur), id)

	uassert.Equal(t, before+questReward, balanceOf(worker))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), escrowTotal)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, paidTotal)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), balanceOf(realmAddr()))
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, active.Size(), "paid quest leaves active")

	q := mustQuestTest(t, id)
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == guild.Paid)
	uassert.False(t, q.AutoPaid)

	wp := findProfile(worker)
	urequire.NotNil(t, wp)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, wp.Paid)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, wp.Accepted)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, wp.AutoAccepted)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, wp.Earned)

	pp := findProfile(poster)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, pp.Spent)
}

func TestAutoAccept(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)

	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr(), ugnot(questReward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	id := Post(cross(cur), "Test quest", "do the thing", lease, review, deadline)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(worker))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://proof.example/1", "done")

	// Still inside the review window: worker cannot claim the payout yet.
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "review window", func() {
		ClaimPayout(cross(cur), id)
	})

	testing.SkipHeights(review + 1)
	ClaimPayout(cross(cur), id)

	q := mustQuestTest(t, id)
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == guild.Paid)
	uassert.True(t, q.AutoPaid)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, balanceOf(worker))
	wp := findProfile(worker)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, wp.AutoAccepted)
}

func TestRejectThenDifferentWorker(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)

	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr(), ugnot(questReward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	id := Post(cross(cur), "Test quest", "do the thing", lease, review, deadline)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(worker))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://proof.example/1", "done")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	Reject(cross(cur), id, "not quite")

	q := mustQuestTest(t, id)
	uassert.True(t, q.Status == guild.Open)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), balanceOf(worker))

	// A different worker claims, submits and gets paid.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(worker2))
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://proof.example/2", "v2")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	Accept(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, balanceOf(worker2))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), balanceOf(worker))
}

func TestLeaseExpiry(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)

	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr(), ugnot(questReward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	id := Post(cross(cur), "Test quest", "do the thing", lease, review, deadline)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(worker))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Claim(cross(cur), id)

	testing.SkipHeights(lease + 1)

	// The original worker's lease is dead: they cannot submit.
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "expired", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "u", "")
	})

	// Another worker picks the quest up.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(worker2))
	Claim(cross(cur), id)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://proof.example/2", "v2")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	Accept(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, questReward, balanceOf(worker2))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), balanceOf(worker))
}

func TestRefund(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetTestState()
	testing.SetHeight(baseH)
	posterBefore := balanceOf(poster)

	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr(), ugnot(questReward))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(poster))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(questReward))
	id := Post(cross(cur), "Test quest", "do the thing", lease, review, deadline)

	// Not before the deadline.

package mqdev2

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	alice = testutils.TestAddress("alice") // rich quester
	bob   = testutils.TestAddress("bob")   // broke quester
	proj  = testutils.TestAddress("proj")  // project
	self  = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1pkghjdzs4xe9j9fhp4va6glkqpc2cuwzslfcjh/mqdev2")
)

// SetRealm only sticks in the calling frame, so tests call it inline.
func as(who address, ugnot int64) {
	testing.SetOriginCaller(who)
	if ugnot > 0 {
		testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", ugnot}})
		testing.IssueCoins(self, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", ugnot}}) // coins land in the realm
	} else {
		testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	}
}

func bal(a address) int64 { return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(a, "ugnot") }

func TestFlow(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.IssueCoins(alice, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 5_000_000}})

	// project locks 2 GNOT for 2 winners (1 GNOT each), hold-check quest
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 2_000_000)
	var id int
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() {
		id = CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Hold 1 GNOT", "Prove you hold GNOT", Common, KindHold, "1000000", PayFixed, 2, 7)
	})
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, id)

	// common project cannot create Epic
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 1_000_000)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "approved projects", func() {
		CreateQuest(cross(cur), "x", "", Epic, KindManual, "", PayFixed, 1, 7)
	})

	// alice passes the check and is paid instantly
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	as(alice, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(6_000_000), bal(alice))
	uassert.True(t, HasCard(alice, 1))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10), PointsOf(alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, Common, BestRarity(alice))

	// double claim blocked
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already claimed", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })

	// bob fails the check
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "check failed", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })

	// refund is locked until expiry
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "locked", func() { Refund(cross(cur), 1) })

	// manual quest: submit -> funder approves -> paid
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 3_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Post on X", "Share your passport", Common, KindManual, "", PayFixed, 3, 7)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Submit(cross(cur), 2, "https://x.com/bob/status/1") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	as(alice, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "funder", func() { Review(cross(cur), 2, bob, true) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Review(cross(cur), 2, bob, true) })
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), bal(bob))

	// legendary needs approval + an Epic first
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	as(admin, 0)
	ApproveProject(cross(cur), proj, true)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 10_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Legend", "", Legendary, KindManual, "", PaySplit, 10, 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	as(alice, 0)
	Submit(cross(cur), 3, "proof")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "Epic card first", func() { Review(cross(cur), 3, alice, true) })

	// after expiry: refund leftover of quest 1, settle split quest 3
	testing.SkipHeights(200_000) // ~11 days of blocks
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "expired", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })
	before := bal(proj)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Refund(cross(cur), 1) })

package mequest

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	alice = testutils.TestAddress("alice") // rich quester
	bob   = testutils.TestAddress("bob")   // broke quester
	proj  = testutils.TestAddress("proj")  // project
	self  = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1pkghjdzs4xe9j9fhp4va6glkqpc2cuwzslfcjh/mequest")
)

// SetRealm only sticks in the calling frame, so tests call it inline.
func as(who address, ugnot int64) {
	testing.SetOriginCaller(who)
	if ugnot > 0 {
		testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", ugnot}})
		testing.IssueCoins(self, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", ugnot}}) // coins land in the realm
	} else {
		testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	}
}

func bal(a address) int64 { return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(a, "ugnot") }

func TestFlow(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	testing.IssueCoins(alice, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 5_000_000}})

	// project locks 2 GNOT for 2 winners (1 GNOT each), hold-check quest
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 2_000_000)
	var id int
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() {
		id = CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Hold 1 GNOT", "Prove you hold GNOT", "wallet", Common, KindHold, "1000000", PayFixed, 2, 7)
	})
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, id)

	// common project cannot create Epic
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 1_000_000)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "approved projects", func() {
		CreateQuest(cross(cur), "x", "", "wallet", Epic, KindManual, "", PayFixed, 1, 7)
	})

	// alice passes the check and is paid instantly
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	as(alice, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(6_000_000), bal(alice))
	uassert.True(t, HasCard(alice, 1))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10), PointsOf(alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, Common, BestRarity(alice))

	// double claim blocked
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already claimed", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })

	// bob fails the check
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "check failed", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })

	// refund is locked until expiry
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "locked", func() { Refund(cross(cur), 1) })

	// manual quest: submit -> funder approves -> paid
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 3_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Post on X", "Share your passport", "wallet", Common, KindManual, "", PayFixed, 3, 7)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Submit(cross(cur), 2, "https://x.com/bob/status/1") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	as(alice, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "funder", func() { Review(cross(cur), 2, bob, true) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Review(cross(cur), 2, bob, true) })
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), bal(bob))

	// legendary needs approval + an Epic first
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	as(admin, 0)
	ApproveProject(cross(cur), proj, true)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 10_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Legend", "", "wallet", Legendary, KindManual, "", PaySplit, 10, 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	as(alice, 0)
	Submit(cross(cur), 3, "proof")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "Epic card first", func() { Review(cross(cur), 3, alice, true) })

	// quest chain: needs card from quest 1 (alice has it, bob doesn't)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 2_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Chain step 2", "", "wallet", Rare, KindCard, "1", PayFixed, 2, 7)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "quest #1 first", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 4) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	as(alice, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Claim(cross(cur), 4) })
	uassert.True(t, HasRarity(alice, Rare))

	// username check
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 1_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Get a name", "", "wallet", Common, KindName, "", PayFixed, 1, 7)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "username", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 5) })

	// after expiry: refund leftover of quest 1, settle split quest 3
	testing.SkipHeights(200_000) // ~11 days of blocks
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	as(bob, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "expired", func() { Claim(cross(cur), 1) })
	before := bal(proj)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(proj))
	as(proj, 0)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Refund(cross(cur), 1) })
	uassert.Equal(t, before+1_000_000, bal(proj))
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Settle(cross(cur), 3) })
	uassert.Equal(t, before+11_000_000, bal(proj)) // no winners: whole split pool back

	// pages render
	uassert.True(t, len(Render("")) > 0)
	uassert.True(t, len(Render("q/1")) > 0)
	uassert.True(t, len(Render("p/"+string(alice))) > 0)
	uassert.True(t, len(Render("top")) > 0)
	for _, path := range []string{"api/stats", "api/quests", "api/q/2", "api/p/" + string(alice), "api/top", "api/feed", "api/projects", "api/receipts"} {
		println("JSON " + Render(path))
	}
}

package mequest

import (
	"chain"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

func fund(who address, ugnot int64) {
	testing.SetOriginCaller(who)
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", ugnot}})
	testing.IssueCoins(self, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", ugnot}})
}

func TestCounterChecks(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	cara := testutils.TestAddress("cara")
	dan := testutils.TestAddress("dan")
	p2 := testutils.TestAddress("project2")

	// quests: 1 check-in, 2 streak 2, 3 early 1, 4 invites 1, 5 projects 2, 6 cards 2, 7 posted, 8 myrealm, 9 grant, 10 path (1,2)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	fund(admin, 10_000_000)
	base := len(quests)
	id := func(n int) int { return base + n }
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "First Check-in", "", "checkin", Common, KindCheckin, "1", PayFixed, 10, 30)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	for _, k := range []struct{ title, art, kind, arg string; r int }{
		{"Week Warrior", "week", KindCheckin, "2", Rare},
		{"Early Bird", "bird", KindEarly, "1", Common},
		{"Recruiter", "recruit", KindInvites, "1", Common},
		{"Explorer", "explorer", KindProjects, "2", Rare},
		{"Founding", "founder", KindCards, "2", Rare},
		{"Quest Maker", "maker", KindPosted, "1", Rare},
		{"First Realm", "realm", KindMyRealm, "", Rare},
		{"Season Champion", "champ", KindGrant, "", Epic},
	} {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
		fund(admin, 1_000_000)
		CreateQuest(cross(cur), k.title, "", k.art, k.r, k.kind, k.arg, PayFixed, 1, 30)
	}
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	fund(admin, 1_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "Starter path", "", "builder", Epic, KindCard, itoa(id(1))+","+itoa(id(2)), PayFixed, 1, 30)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)

	// cara: invited by dan, checks in day 1
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(cara))
	testing.SetOriginCaller(cara)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { SetInviter(cross(cur), dan) })
	uassert.Equal(t, "check failed: check-in streak is 0, needs 1", CanClaim(cara, id(1)))
	CheckIn(cross(cur))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already checked in", func() { CheckIn(cross(cur)) })
	uassert.Equal(t, "ok", CanClaim(cara, id(1)))
	Claim(cross(cur), id(1))
	uassert.True(t, HasCard(cara, id(1)))
	// streak of 2 needs tomorrow
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "streak is 1", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(2)) })
	testing.SkipHeights(17_280) // ~1 day
	CheckIn(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, StreakOf(cara))
	Claim(cross(cur), id(2))
	// early bird: admin joined first (rank 1), cara is not in the first 1
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the first 1", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(3)) })
	// cards: cara has 2 now (only from admin = 1 project)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(6)) })
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "1 projects", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(5)) })
	// starter path: owns quests 1 and 2
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(10)) })
	// dan's invite counts once cara got her first card
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, InvitesDone(dan))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "inviter already set", func() { SetInviter(cross(cur), dan) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dan))
	testing.SetOriginCaller(dan)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(4)) })
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "post a funded quest", func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(7)) })

	// project2 posts a quest -> quest maker
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(p2))
	fund(p2, 1_000_000)
	CreateQuest(cross(cur), "P2 hold", "", "wallet", Common, KindHold, "1", PayFixed, 1, 30)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Claim(cross(cur), id(7)) })

	// first realm: only a realm under the wallet's own address works
	testing.SetOriginCaller(dan)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/" + string(cara) + "/hello"))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "call this from a realm under", func() { ProveRealm(cross(cur), id(8)) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/" + string(dan) + "/hello"))
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { ProveRealm(cross(cur), id(8)) })
	uassert.True(t, HasCard(dan, id(8)))

	// grant: only the funder
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dan))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the quest funder", func() { Grant(cross(cur), id(9), dan) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(admin))
	urequire.NotPanics(t, cur, func() { Grant(cross(cur), id(9), cara) })
	uassert.Equal(t, Epic, BestRarity(cara))
	println("JSON " + Render("api/p/"+string(cara)))
}
